reviews.text: Best musti ja mirri in my opinion!
Excellent customer service. Good products always available. There are also always enough promotional and campaign products.
Always happy & helpful staff 💚 …
Thank you for your friendly service.
Really great. First time here. I'll go again.

Horrible customer service experience. My dog and I went and the clerk working was looking so mean, she just gave us a death stare and her energy was off. I overheard her name was Sini, Sieni or something with S, Saturday March 7 closing shift. The only time she opened her mouth was when she yelled to us across from the store that it was closing. I replied thank you and told her that this was the first time nobody ever greeted us while visiting the store. I told her I didn’t care if she greeted me but at least she could greet my dog, since it’s a store for them.
I have been buy some of cats medicine from thise store
Friendly service 😊❤️ …
Special thanks to the customer service representative from the morning of January 2, 2026! Very friendly, helpful and experienced professional 😊💯 …
They took good care of the rabbit's nails, even though they are a sensitive breed. The appointment was booked quickly, and the friendly staff guided us through everything we had to do.

I went there to get my puppy a technical groom which was supposed to include a facial clean, a trim as well as trimming paws. The only thing that was done for Kofi was just trimming his paws. They simply said he refused to get his face touched and didn't touch any of it they also didn't give him a trim even in the back it was barely noticeable. They gave him back to me 10 minutes before the time allotted to him and simply said sorry and charged me the full price. I was in shock and said I like the nail trimming as it was the most grown part but I would say, save your money. I was able to get trimming scissors right after that horrible visit and he cooperated and now has a much better trim from a first timer. Really bad and unsatisfactory service. She was friendly if it helps.

Wonderful and professional staff! Nora, who did our dog's "manicure", knows how to handle our 20kg son, who is sensitive to nail trimming, very well, she is the first groomer that my husband approves of😍❤️ …

Musti ja Mirri in Helsinki Hakaniemi offers friendly service and a great selection of pet supplies. Staff are knowledgeable and helpful, and the store is clean and well-organized. Perfect for quick stops or bigger hauls. Highly recommended for pet owners nearby!

It was supposed to be open on Saturday from 10am to 5pm. It wasn't open on Saturday 1st February at 12:10pm. There was no announcement online and no sign on the door. Couldn't make any purchases then. Hello, what is this??
Extensive selection of supplies, good, friendly and knowledgeable customer service.
The friendly spirit helped with all the necessary things related to the new puppy, plus I got a great puppy package for Free.. Food and a toy. Good benefits as well.
Friendly and helpful staff but expensive prices
Our dog thanks us for the place
Musti ja Mirri in Helsinki Hakaniemi is the go-to spot for dog owners! They have an impressive selection of dog gear, from treats to toys, and the staff is super friendly and helpful.
